meta.name: ccs-align
meta.description: Run the CCS Align seat's hourly breathing cycle — prove the local claude-mem worker is healthy, pull needle observations through search → timeline → get_observations, land them in a seat-owned middle cache via atomic grab → append → filter exclude-marks → replace, manage exclude marks, and walk house → project → seat rules to detect conflicts (SHADOW_HOUSE, DENY_ALLOW, DRIFT, CLOCK_HEADER) with an append-only rules-report.md. Use when asked to run CCS Align, breathe the alignment seat, refresh the middle cache, exclude or restore an observation, walk rules, check rules conflicts, or check the Worker Watch board.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动巡检并维护AI记忆服务,同时发现规则冲突报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理本地AI记忆服务,希望每小时自动检查并整理它。
copy.tagline_en: Run hourly checks on AI memory, refresh its cache, and catch rule conflicts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a local AI memory service and want its cache and rules checked hourly.

howto.what: 每小时替你跑一次 CCS Align：先确认本地 claude-mem worker 在运行，再把最近的 needle 观察抓进座位自己的 middle.jsonl 缓存，可按标记排除或恢复某条记录，每 6 小时走一遍规则并追加 rules-report.md。
howto.when: 当你要求运行 CCS Align 的呼吸循环——刷新 middle 缓存、排除或恢复观察、走查规则等——时触发，以原文的 use when 为准。

howto.what_en: Each hour it proves the local claude-mem worker is healthy, pulls needle observations into a seat-owned middle.jsonl cache, lets you exclude or restore an observation, and every 6th hour appends a rules-report.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to run CCS Align, breathe the alignment seat, refresh the middle cache, or exclude/restore an observation, walk rules, or check the Worker Watch board.

say_en.text: Run a CCS Align breathing cycle and cache the latest needle observations.

say_en.note: Drops from the compiled cache, not the diary.

say_en.text: Walk house → project → seat rules and report conflicts.
